#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const long long MOD = 1000000007LL;

long long powerMod(long long base, long long exp) {
    long long res = 1;
    while (exp != 0) {
        if (exp & 1LL) res = (res * base) % MOD;
        exp >>= 1LL;
        base = (base * base) % MOD;
    }
    return res;
}

class UnionFind {
private:
    vector<int> parent;
    vector<int> rnk;
public:
    UnionFind(int n) {
        parent.assign(n, 0);
        rnk.assign(n, 0);
        if (n > 0) {
            parent[0] = 0;
            rnk[0] = 0;
        }
        for (int i = 1; i < n; ++i) {
            parent[i] = i;
            rnk[i] = 1;
        }
    }

    int find(int x) {
        if (parent[x] != x)
            parent[x] = find(parent[x]);
        return parent[x];
    }

    void unite(int a, int b) {
        int ra = find(a);
        int rb = find(b);
        if (ra == rb) return;
        if (rnk[ra] >= rnk[rb]) {
            parent[rb] = ra;
            ++rnk[ra];
        } else {
            parent[ra] = rb;
            ++rnk[rb];
        }
    }
};

int main() {
    int P, K;
    scanf("%d%d", &P, &K);

    UnionFind uf(P);

    for (int i = 1; i < P; ++i) {
        int value = (int)((long long)K * i % P);
        uf.unite(i, value);
    }

    set<int> groups;
    for (int i = 1; i < P; ++i)
        groups.insert(uf.find(i));

    long long ways;
    if (K == 0)
        ways = powerMod(P, P - 1);
    else if (K == 1)
        ways = powerMod(P, P);
    else
        ways = powerMod(P, (long long)groups.size());

    printf("%lld\n", ways);
    return 0;
}

const long long MOD = 1000000007LL;

long long modPow(long long a, long long e) {
    long long r = 1;
    while (e) {
        if (e & 1LL) r = (r * a) % MOD;
        a = (a * a) % MOD;
        e >>= 1LL;
    }
    return r;
}

int main() {
    int P, K;
    scanf("%d%d", &P, &K);

    vector<int> head(P, -1);
    vector<int> to(max(0, 2 * (P - 1)));
    vector<int> next(max(0, 2 * (P - 1)));
    int edgeCnt = 0;

    auto addEdge = [&](int u, int v) {
        to[edgeCnt] = v;
        next[edgeCnt] = head[u];
        head[u] = edgeCnt++;
    };

    for (int i = 1; i < P; ++i) {
        int j = (int)((long long)K * i % P);
        addEdge(i, j);
        addEdge(j, i);
    }

    vector<char> visited(P, 0);
    int relevantComponents = 0;

    for (int s = 0; s < P; ++s) {
        if (visited[s]) continue;

        bool containsNonZero = (s != 0);
        vector<int> st;
        st.push_back(s);
        visited[s] = 1;

        while (!st.empty()) {
            int u = st.back();
            st.pop_back();

            if (u != 0)
                containsNonZero = true;

            for (int e = head[u]; e != -1; e = next[e]) {
                int v = to[e];
                if (!visited[v]) {
                    visited[v] = 1;
                    st.push_back(v);
                }
            }
        }

        if (containsNonZero)
            ++relevantComponents;
    }

    long long ways;
    if (K == 0)
        ways = modPow(P, P - 1);
    else if (K == 1)
        ways = modPow(P, P);
    else
        ways = modPow(P, relevantComponents);

    printf("%lld\n", ways);
    return 0;
}
